inherited.behaviour: cleared for every artifact. The method is observation and respecification, not copying, so a licence that forbids source use narrows the method rather than blocking the work.
inherited.branding: prohibited wherever a mod declares a logo. A mod logo belongs to the author who drew it, and this workspace reproduces none of them. The pack branding, quests and scripts were prohibited by M5-W1 for the same reason: they name material nothing here extracts, so no later review clears them.
inherited.names: unresolved for every artifact. Whether an original mod id may be advertised is an interoperability question SPEC.md 7.3 defers, and M5-W1 already recorded it that way for the pack.
